text: Phase 3 conditional plan reaffirmed: B5 remains blocked until the B4 receipt localizes a fine-model or export-halo failure. If oracle BasinBridge enters a residual basin no larger than 4 mm but frozen HalfFlow stalls, first test rank-one scaling against an analytic or differential oracle at matched runtime; only then test dual-anchored symmetry for midpoint blur. Exercise the true computational halo separately. Each branch needs a predeclared B4 trigger, one-factor comparison, JVM/Scala.js correctness coverage, performance evidence, and retain/reject receipt. Matcher confidence, feature, subvoxel, or search changes belong in a new narrow matcher child, not B5.
